gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: A negative threshold is rejected by the constructor with an IllegalArgumentException ("Threshold must not be negative").
ADDED i4: With no threshold, inserting one leading character ("@" -> "*@") yields a distance of 1.
ADDED i5: With no threshold, comparing an empty 116-char buffer against a zero-length slice of itself counts 116 insertions.
ADDED i6: With no threshold, two empty strings have a distance of 0.
ADDED i7: With no threshold, applying the algorithm to two null inputs throws IllegalArgumentException ("Left/right inputs must not be null").
ADDED i10: With a threshold of 0, comparing an empty 1-char buffer against a buffer holding '%' would cost 1 operation, which exceeds the threshold and so returns -1.
ADDED i11: With a threshold of 15, two empty buffers of length 15 and 332 differ in length by more than the threshold, so the result is -1.
ADDED i12: With a threshold of 582, comparing an empty 582-char buffer against a zero-length slice of itself costs 582 insertions, which equals the threshold and is theref
ADDED i13: Even with a threshold set, applying the algorithm to two null inputs throws IllegalArgumentException ("Left/right inputs must not be null").
ADDED i16: With a threshold of 0, an empty buffer compared against a 16-char string needs 16 insertions, which exceeds the threshold and returns -1.
ADDED i17: With a threshold of 4, comparing a buffer against itself yields a distance of 0, well within the threshold.
ADDED i18: With no threshold, two identical (long) strings have a distance of 0.
ADDED i19: The default constructor leaves the threshold unset (null).
